", "sp_upsert": "CREATE OR ALTER PROC [dbo].[sp_leadCaptures]
    @pjsonfile VARCHAR(MAX)
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE @Outputmessage NVARCHAR(MAX) = '{
  "result": [
    { "value": "", "msg": "", "error": "" }
  ]
}'
BEGIN TRY
    BEGIN TRANSACTION;

    DECLARE @action INT = (
        SELECT TOP 1 TRY_CONVERT(INT, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.action'))
        FROM OPENJSON(@pjsonfile, '$.leadCaptures')
    );

    DECLARE @payload TABLE (
        leadCaptureId   INT NULL,
        companyId       INT NULL,
        fullName        NVARCHAR(150) NULL,
        email           NVARCHAR(150) NULL,
        companyName     NVARCHAR(200) NULL,
        phone           NVARCHAR(20) NULL,
        jobTitle        NVARCHAR(100) NULL,
        message         NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL,
        leadSource      NVARCHAR(50) NULL,
        interestArea    NVARCHAR(50) NULL,
        status          NVARCHAR(20) NULL,
        assignedTo      INT NULL,
        privacyConsentAccepted BIT NULL
    );

    INSERT INTO @payload (
        leadCaptureId,
        companyId,
        fullName,
        email,
        companyName,
        phone,
        jobTitle,
        message,
        leadSource,
        interestArea,
        status,
        assignedTo,
        privacyConsentAccepted
    )
    SELECT
        TRY_CONVERT(INT, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.leadCaptureId')),
        TRY_CONVERT(INT, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.companyId')),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.fullName'),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.email'),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.companyName'),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.phone'),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.jobTitle'),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.message'),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.leadSource'),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.interestArea'),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.status'),
        TRY_CONVERT(INT, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.assignedTo')),
        TRY_CONVERT(BIT, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.privacyConsentAccepted'))
    FROM OPENJSON(@pjsonfile, '$.leadCaptures');

    IF @action = 1 -- INSERT
    BEGIN
        -- Validate for duplicate emails within the payload itself
        IF EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM @payload
            GROUP BY LOWER(RTRIM(LTRIM(email)))
            HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
        )
        BEGIN
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].error', '1');
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', 'Duplicate email entries within the payload.');
            COMMIT TRANSACTION;
            GOTO Finish;
        END

        -- Validate for duplicate emails against existing records
        IF EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.leadCaptures lc
            INNER JOIN @payload p ON lc.normalizedEmail = LOWER(RTRIM(LTRIM(p.email)))
        )
        BEGIN
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].error', '1');
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', 'Lead with this email already exists.');
            COMMIT TRANSACTION;
            GOTO Finish;
        END

        INSERT INTO dbo.leadCaptures (
            companyId,
            fullName,
            email,
            companyName,
            phone,
            jobTitle,
            message,
            leadSource,
            interestArea,
            status,
            assignedTo,
            privacyConsentAccepted,
            created_At
        )
        SELECT
            p.companyId,
            p.fullName,
            p.email,
            p.companyName,
            p.phone,
            p.jobTitle,
            p.message,
            p.leadSource,
            p.interestArea,
            p.status,
            p.assignedTo,
            p.privacyConsentAccepted,
            GETDATE()
        FROM @payload p;
    END
    ELSE IF @action = 2 -- UPDATE
    BEGIN
        -- Validate for duplicate emails within the payload itself, excluding the record being updated
        IF EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM @payload p_inner
            WHERE p_inner.leadCaptureId IS NOT NULL
            GROUP BY LOWER(RTRIM(LTRIM(p_inner.email)))
            HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
        )
        BEGIN
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].error', '1');
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', 'Duplicate email entries within the payload for update operation.');
            COMMIT TRANSACTION;
            GOTO Finish;
        END

        -- Validate for duplicate emails against existing records, excluding the record being updated itself
        IF EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.leadCaptures lc
            INNER JOIN @payload p ON lc.normalizedEmail = LOWER(RTRIM(LTRIM(p.email)))
            WHERE lc.leadCaptureId <> p.leadCaptureId
        )
        BEGIN
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].error', '1');
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', 'Lead with this email already exists for another record.');
            COMMIT TRANSACTION;
            GOTO Finish;
        END

        UPDATE lc
        SET
            companyId       = p.companyId,
            fullName        = p.fullName,
            email           = p.email,
            companyName     = p.companyName,
            phone           = p.phone,
            jobTitle        = p.jobTitle,
            message         = p.message,
            leadSource      = p.leadSource,
            interestArea    = p.interestArea,
            status          = p.status,
            assignedTo      = p.assignedTo,
            privacyConsentAccepted = p.privacyConsentAccepted,
            updated_at      = GETDATE()
        FROM dbo.leadCaptures lc
        INNER JOIN @payload p ON lc.leadCaptureId = p.leadCaptureId;
    END
    ELSE IF @action = 3 -- DELETE
    BEGIN
        DELETE lc
        FROM dbo.leadCaptures lc
        INNER JOIN @payload p ON lc.leadCaptureId = p.leadCaptureId;
    END

    SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', 'Inserted/Updated/Deleted Successfully');
    COMMIT TRANSACTION;

        JSON_VALUE(value,'$.value') AS value,
        JSON_VALUE(value,'$.msg')   AS msg,
        JSON_VALUE(value,'$.error') AS error
    FROM OPENJSON(@Outputmessage,'$.result');

END TRY
BEGIN CATCH
    IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
        ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
    SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].error', '1');
    SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', ERROR_MESSAGE());
    SELECT
        JSON_VALUE(value,'$.value') AS value,
        JSON_VALUE(value,'$.msg')   AS msg,
        JSON_VALUE(value,'$.error') AS error
    FROM OPENJSON(@Outputmessage,'$.result');
END CATCH;
